name: Island
overview: Scripture reveals that islands, or isles, are significant in God's sovereign plan, often representing distant peoples who will recognize His authority and gather for His judgment. The psalmist celebrates the multitude of isles rejoicing under the LORD's reign, while Isaiah prophesies the Lord's gathering of His people from various lands, including the islands of the sea. The islands are called to listen and renew strength before God’s judgment, and they will fear and come near in recognition of His power. Ultimately, Zephaniah declares that all the isles will worship the LORD alone as He humbles the false gods of the earth.
